messages:
Jordan (sales-eng): Hey team — Finexa SIG thread. They asked for question 3.2 (KMS rotation policy), 4.1 (access reviews), and attestation for SOC controls. Need solid artifacts by EOD Friday. Who can own each?
Alex Chen: I can take KMS rotation + key inventory. Have a `kms-rotation-2025.pdf` and `key-inventory.xlsx` on secure-docs. Will pull.
Samira Patel: I can own access reviews. We have quarterly review exports from Okta — `okta-access-review-2024Q4.csv`. Will sanitize and upload.
Jordan (sales-eng): Awesome. Leah can you confirm SOC attestation status and whether we can share the report redacted?
Leah Kim: SOC2 Type II report is available via our vendor portal but it has customer-sensitive sections. I can produce a redacted version (remove customer names) and an executive summary. ETA tomorrow AM.
Mike O'Neill: Pricing / POC note — Finexa is asking about Dedicated capacity uplift during POC. I told them we'd estimate based on expected RPS. Samira, do you need a pricing number to include in the SIG answers?
Samira Patel: Yes please, even ballpark. If we commit to a 2-week POC with 1 GPU dedicated, we usually quote the short-term uplift rate + usage. Mike, can you DM the number or drop the snapshot here? :eyes:
Mike O'Neill: Dropping the snapshot below and will DM the final.
Mike O'Neill: ```Pricing snapshot: POC Dedicated uplift (2-week): $8,500 flat + per-token usage. Long-term commit discounts apply. Contact pricing@redwood.com for contract.```
Jordan (sales-eng): Perfect, thanks. Back to evidence: can sec-bot ingest the artifacts and generate a share link so we can attach to the SIG response?
sec-bot: Artifact upload complete — 3 files to share. Links: https://s3.redwood.internal/finexa/kms-rotation-2025.pdf, https://s3.redwood.internal/finexa/okta-access-review-2024Q4.csv, https://s3.redwood.internal/finexa/soc2-exec-summary.pdf :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: I reviewed the `kms-rotation-2025.pdf` — it includes rotation cadence (90 days), rotation owners, and rotation logs sample. I will also export KMS rotation log snippet: `kms-rotation-log-20250103.txt`.
Leah Kim: For SOC redaction — FYI legal OK'd sharing executive summary but not full control matrices with vendor names. I'll attach the redacted file to the S3 path and flag the exact sections to include in the SIG answer.
Samira Patel: One more: SIG Q6 asks about privileged access reviews. I can provide the policy doc `priv-access-policy.md` and last review date.
Jordan (sales-eng): Great. Let's map owners to questions here so I can fill the form: 3.2 -> Alex (KMS docs + log), 4.1 -> Samira (Okta export + policy), 5.7 -> Leah (SOC exec summary), 6.1 -> Samira (priv access). Anyone object?
Alex Chen: No objection. I'll upload the log to the S3 path now.
sec-bot: New object uploaded: s3://redwood-secureshare/finexa/kms-rotation-log-20250103.txt
Jordan (sales-eng): Timeline check — I need everything in by Friday 17:00 PT. If any blockers, flag them here by Thursday EOD so we can escalate.
Leah Kim: Small blocker: SOC redaction review may take until Thursday lunchtime. If legal delays, we'll hand the exec summary and note pending items in the SIG response.
Samira Patel: Okta export has PII — I'll scrub usernames and replace with hashed placeholders before upload. ETA Thursday noon.
Mike O'Neill: I also flagged customer question on encryption in transit — answer is TLS1.2+ enforced, mTLS optional for Private deployments. I'll paste the sentence to include: "All customer traffic is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher; private deployments support mutual TLS."
Jordan (sales-eng): Nice. I'll draft the SIG entries as soon as links are live. Once uploaded, I'll paste the final answers here for a quick sanity check before submission.
Alex Chen: Uploaded `kms-rotation-2025.pdf` and `kms-rotation-log-20250103.txt` to the s3 path.
sec-bot: Files now available: https://s3.redwood.internal/finexa/kms-rotation-2025.pdf, https://s3.redwood.internal/finexa/kms-rotation-log-20250103.txt
Samira Patel: Okta export sanitized and uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/finexa/okta-access-review-2024Q4-sanitized.csv
Leah Kim: SOC exec summary uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/finexa/soc2-exec-summary-redacted.pdf
Jordan (sales-eng): Amazing — I'll assemble and post the completed SIG Q&A draft here in ~90 minutes for review. Thanks team :tada:
